tei:div.tei:p: phyag rgya bzhi'i zur 'debs kyi thog mar dam rgya ni/ lha rnams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su thog mtha' med pa'i chos nyid kyi ngo bo dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mtshan par gyur/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛ sh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ zhes snying po lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ de bzhin du/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod| sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ ces lan gsum/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ zhes lan gsum/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ oṃ sarba bid dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ ces lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ ces lan gsum/ de bzhin du/ ༈ su ra te s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ bud+dha lo tsa ni dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ bud+dha lo tsa ni/ zhes lan gsum/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ su ra te s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ badz+ra mā ma kī dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ badz+ra mā ma kī/ zhes lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī trāṃ/ zhes lan gsum/ de bzhin du kun la snying po'i sngags so so la sbyar nas rig 'gre'o// badz+ra pāṇ+ḍa ri/ oṃ badz+ra pāṇ+ḍa ri hrīḥ badz+ra tā re/ oṃ badz+ra tā re āḥ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra rā ga hoḥ

oṃ badz+ra sā dhu dhu/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra te dza r+ya/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu bh+ri/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣa ṇa dhīḥ oṃ badz+ra he tu kruṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa bhā/ oṃ badz+ra karma kaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa k+ṣaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhi ṣ+ṭaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nṛt+ye āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ ༈ kalpa bha dra/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri sho dha na dharma te ga ga na sa mud+ga te ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ ༈ /shra wa ka /rtsa rig brjod/ pra t+yeka /rtsa rig brjod/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ badz+ra kro dha dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ/ badz+ra kro dha/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rtsa rig lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa chos rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mdun gyi 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa chur nyal ba/ rdo rje'i lte bar lha rang rang gi sngags kyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwā/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra sogs/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa las rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ gar dang glu dang ro dang zas// spyod lam la sogs bde ba rnams// sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni// las kyi phyag rgyas dbang du 'gyur// sarba bid/

sarba bid/ sarba bid/ sarba bid/ sarba bid/ bud+dha lo tsa ni/ zhes pa nas/ badz+ra kro dha/ zhes pa'i bar du brjod/ bzhi pa phyag chen ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du thog ma'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ sarba bid/ sogs nas/ badz+ra kro dha'i bar gong ltar brjod nas/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de ltar dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ ces dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ shākya ri dbang dang*/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ me tog cher rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te rtsa rig kun la 'gre'o/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni hūm̐/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī trāṃ/ rdo rje mā ma kī dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pāṇ+ḍa ri hrīḥ gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tā re āḥ sgrol ma ste/ yum bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza dzaḥ rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga hoḥ rdo rje chags pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sā dhu dhu/ rdo rje legs pa ste/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na trāṃ/ rdo rje rin chen dang*/ oṃ badz+ra te dza r+ya/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu bh+ri/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā/ rdo rje bzhad pa ste/ lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ rdo rje chos dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣa ṇa dhīḥ rdo rje rnon po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra he tu kruṃ/ rdo rje rgyu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa bhā/ rdo rje smra ba ste/ nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya| tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra karma kaṃ/ rdo rje las dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa raṃ/ rdo rje srung ba dang*| oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa k+ṣaṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*/ oṃ badz+ra san+dhiṣ+ṭaṃ/ rdo rje khu tshur te/ byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ sgeg mo ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ rdo rje phreng ba ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ glu ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nṛt+ye āḥ gar ma ste/ nang gi sgeg mo bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ bdug spos ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ me tog ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ snang gsal ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ dri chab ma ste/ phyi yi sgeg mo bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ rdo rje 'bebs pa ste/ sgo ma bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa mud+ga te ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan mun 'joms/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog /'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ dra ba can/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po ste/ bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug gis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ maud+gal gyi bu/ rab 'byor/ 'char ka /ma 'gags pa/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya/ nye bar 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag /kun dga' bo/ ming chen/ nor 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung ste/ nyan thos chen po bcu drug gis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol| oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig dang*/ gdung ba sel ba/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ smra ba'i sgra gcan/ bse ru lta bu/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston| seng ge sgra/ 'jigs pa med pa/ ri bo rgyal/ dug chen 'joms pa/ yid myur ba ste/ rang rgyal chen po bcu gnyis kyis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya| tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes dang*/ khro bo bzhi/ bran bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi| khro tshogs chen po bcu drug gis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes so// //gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs thung ni/ oṃ na ma s+t+rai ya dhi' kā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbahe dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dharma dhā tu garbahe/ saṃ ha ra ma ma ā yu saṃ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa man+toṣ+ṇī ṣa bi ma le bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

aṃ baṃ saṃ dzaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs thung ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ma mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.aṃ aḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba satwā sh+tsa swā hā/ zhes byang chog skabs su sbyar bar bya'o// //
